question: Which of the following countries hosted the Asian Football Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is **__United Arab Emirates.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The 17th AFC (Football) Asian Cup of 2019 was held in UAE (United Arab Emirates).
 
• The winner of this tournament was Qatar and the runner-up was Japan.
 
• This was the first time Qatar had won the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• AFC stands for Asian Football Confederation.
 
• It was founded in 1954 and its headquarters was in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
• The 18th AFC Cup 2023 will be held in China.
